$schema_note: Justworks-specific system lane colors. Extends palettes/colors.json. Use these when building maps for Justworks' GTM stack (Customer.io, Salesforce, Default, LaunchDarkly, prospect-facing surfaces).

customer_io.purpose: Customer.io lane. Indigo family to align with the CIO logo.

default.purpose: Default (workflow automation platform) lane. Blue family.

launchdarkly.purpose: LaunchDarkly feature flag lane. Red family.

prospect_browser.purpose: Prospect-facing browser/form lane (the user's experience). Orange family.

naming_conventions.experiment_fields: Standardize on experiment_name and experiment_variant across all A/B test maps. If a downstream system uses experiment_arm, note the naming inconsistency in the Gap & Risk Review.
naming_conventions.lead_record_types: Sales Beach RT, Prospective Partner RT, Event Lead (Event is a separate SFDC object, not a Lead RT).
